settings.question: How big is it?
settings.answer: Compact and portable at approximately 8x8cm. Small enough for any surface but powerful enough to light up an entire room.

settings.question: How many colors does it have?
settings.answer: 16 color options controllable instantly with the included remote. No app or WiFi needed.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: 7-14 business days across Europe. Tracking number provided as soon as your order ships.

settings.question: Is it safe to leave on overnight?
settings.answer: Yes — energy efficient LED stays cool to the touch even after hours of use.

settings.question: How fast is shipping?
settings.answer: We process orders within 24-72 hours and deliver them within 6-15 days depending on your location, with tracked shipment included for your convenience.

settings.question: How do I get in contact?
settings.answer: You can message support by clicking the "Contact Us" section on our store.
